title: Sordland/Turn07/A_ResultsMeeting
description: Discuss the results with core team.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian held the door for me and we..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian held the door for me and we both left the office for the White Room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One by one, my ministers packed up..."
entries.dialogueText: One by one, my ministers packed up and left the White Room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The last two and a half years had g..."
entries.dialogueText: The last two and a half years had gone by so fast.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stared at the secret phone in my..."
entries.dialogueText: I stared at the secret phone in my office and thought about what Remus Holstron had told me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wasn't sure if using Karl to go a..."
entries.dialogueText: I wasn't sure if using Karl to go against the Old Guard was a sound choice. I wondered if he could be trusted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Maybe this was the time to take adv..."
entries.dialogueText: Maybe this was the time to take advantage of my cooperation with the Young Sords.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I called the number Remus gave me."
entries.dialogueText: I called the number Remus gave me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "But I decided against it."
entries.dialogueText: But I decided against it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Maybe this was the time to take adv..."
entries.dialogueText: Maybe this was the time to take advantage of my cooperation with the Young Sords again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus, however, stayed behind."
entries.dialogueText: Gus, however, stayed behind.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I left the White Room and headed to..."
entries.dialogueText: I left the White Room and headed to my office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I followed suit and headed to my of..."
entries.dialogueText: I followed suit and headed to my office.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“In a few years the vineyard may ev..."
entries.dialogueText: “In a few years the vineyard may even challenge its regional rivals. But it would need some further attention to rank among Sordland's best.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“FC Anrica has seen a boost in tick..."
entries.dialogueText: “FC Anrica has seen a boost in ticket sales following your endorsement and participation in the club. The management decided to send over a slice of that pie.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The management of Underhall has de..."
entries.dialogueText: “The management of Underhall has decided to send big bonuses to the board after high revenue growth this quarter.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Several construction projects have..."
entries.dialogueText: “Several construction projects have been accomplished around the country. The company coffers are full and we stand to benefit.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Your vineyard in Erlory has begun..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your vineyard in Erlory has begun producing some wine. I have also arranged for several tasting sessions in order to sample the product and give ideas on how to improve the quality.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The manager personally thanked you..."
entries.dialogueText: “The manager personally thanked you for the support you have shown the team. Several players have already decided to join the USP.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Since its successful contract win,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Since its successful contract win, the company has received and accepted numerous several mega-projects in other countries. Underhall's future is looking bright.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Mr. President. Just a quick word r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. Just a quick word regarding the investment I arranged for you."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The money should be arriving in yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “The money should be arriving in your account shortly.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The manager personally thanked you..."
entries.dialogueText: “The manager personally thanked you for the support you have shown and wanted me to relay that he is no fan of Mayor Leste either.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's great news, Gus.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's great news, Gus."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rayne Wines. I can't wait.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rayne Wines. I can't wait."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""What did I tell you, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: "What did I tell you, Mr. President? Take a little risk and it'll pay off in the end."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So awarding Underhall a government..."
entries.dialogueText: "So awarding Underhall a government contract caused me to benefit personally. That doesn't sound entirely above-board."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Always, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Always, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Don't worry. Nobody else needs to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. Nobody else needs to know about this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is the team winning?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is the team winning?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""FC Anrica? Actually, they've been..."
entries.dialogueText: "FC Anrica? Actually, they've been playing a lot better than in recent years. You should check out a match sometime."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are your investments doing well to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are your investments doing well too?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""It's a pleasure doing business wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a pleasure doing business with you. And Ewald sends his greetings."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""And they're happy to receive that..."
entries.dialogueText: "And they're happy to receive that support. Truly a two-way street."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""It's a pleasure doing business wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a pleasure doing business with you."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I look forward to opening the firs..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to opening the first bottle with you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm just happy to support Sordish..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just happy to support Sordish businesses."
